faqs.question: What services does BluJoy Labs provide?
faqs.answer: We support government contractors with capture and proposal services, help you turn a use case into a working AI solution, and provide brand, product and website design and development.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Share your pursuit, use case or project through our contact form. We'll discuss your priorities and recommend the right starting point.

faqs.question: Can you help with more than one service?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many clients work with us across GovCon support, AI consulting and design and engineering — each engagement is scoped individually.

faqs.question: Do you offer a free consultation?
faqs.answer: Yes — we start with a free introductory conversation to understand your needs before recommending a scope.
